title: GG 3 · Add reserve: same checks as Make payment
walkthroughSteps: Add reserve uses the same warning list as Make payment, so the two journeys look the same (BMPCC-20953).

acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
**Opens:** Reserves with Add reserve open, EUR 900,000 on Business Interruption.

**You see:** Same amber warning as Make payment, same amount left on the limit. No reason field (reserves don't need one).
